info.name: Pioneer XDJ-XZ
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ mapping for the XDJ-XZ all-in-one in PC control (MIDI) mode: four decks, hot cue, pad FX, beat jump and sampler pads, jog displays; the XDJ-XZ mixes on its own mixer. Beta: written from AlphaTheta's XDJ-XZ MIDI message list and rekordbox's XDJ-XZ mapping, not yet tried on the hardware.
